title: doctor.item@1
description: One item deep doctor shows: a stable code from the extensible doctor family, its level, the evidence read and the fix. A reader at an earlier minor takes a code it doesn't know for unknown, never for a success.

code.description: What the item found: healthy when the check ran and found nothing wrong; not_checked when nobody ran it, never ok.

x-closure.closed: the values come from agents and tools that add new ones; a reader at an earlier minor reads a value it does not know as unknown
x-closure.reopens: a minor that adds a code; a reader at the earlier minor takes it for unknown

x-closure.closed: each value is a state the record defines and every reader acts on, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

evidence.description: What was read: a path, a version, an exit code.
